The matrix is the framework's canonical early-warning signal — spot drawdown leads contract direction by 6-10 weeks. Matrix engine: src/data/cycle_matrix.py; charts: src/analysis/chart_generator.py.

COLS (spot drawdown from rolling 12w peak): C1 at peak, C2 <5% off, C3 5-10% off, C4 10-20% off, C5 >=20% off. Not fired = R1/R2 with low drawdown (full position). indicator_assessments.name: Hyperscaler CapEx plateau (rate stabilizes)
indicator_assessments.description: Hyperscalers keep spending at enormous scale but STOP ACCELERATING — next-period guidance lands flat vs the prior baseline. This is the 'infrastructure is built' moment: a peak-confirmation signal, distinct from CapEx acceleration (t2_capex_parabolic, boom fuel) and from CapEx cuts (Tier 4, bust confirmation).
indicator_assessments.what_to_look_for: Measured per company (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, META), per print, against that company's OWN PRIOR FORWARD GUIDANCE for the same period — the signal is the SURPRISE in forward guidance, not the level and not YoY actuals. RAISE >5% above prior guidance = NOT at plateau (still accelerating). REITERATE/CONFIRM within ±5% of prior guidance = AT PLATEAU — merely confirming the number IS the event; the upward surprises have stopped. CUT >5% below prior guidance = hands off to the Tier 4 cut/idling family, and this signal PERSISTS (progression, not reversal). HARD RULE — qualifiers cannot override numbers: verbal growth language ('year-over-year growth expected') attached to a reiterated number does NOT disqualify the plateau. CANONICAL FIRE (2026-07-30): Microsoft FY27 CapEx $190B against a $190B prior baseline = at plateau. FORBIDDEN COUNTEREXAMPLE (2026-07-31): Layer 2 classified that exact print Not fired, reasoning 'guidance is AT baseline, not flat vs prior' and letting the growth qualifier override the reiterated number — both escapes are forbidden; AT the prior number IS the plateau. WITHHELD GUIDANCE: a company that previously gave forward guidance and now declines to guide (Meta 2026-07-30: gave 2026 at $137.5B, withheld 2027) does NOT count toward the plateau tally — there is no number to compare — but MUST be surfaced on this card as a watch flag ('withheld forward guidance'): refusal to guide higher is a soft tell. STATUS LADDER (v3.44.0): count companies at plateau on their latest print — 1-2 = Partially fired; 3-4 = Fired.
